purpose: Communicate how the company operates and what it values as a list of short titled statements, each a two-column row (bold title left, explanatory sentence right), so culture reads as clear commitments rather than a paragraph.

behaviour.note: Appears twice on /careers with different data and spacing: How we operate (3 rows, each with a bold lead-in sentence followed by a longer explanation) and Our core values (5 rows, plain body). Both sit on gray-2 with a top pattern strip.
The same row pattern (title in 5-6 columns, body in 13-15 columns) is used inline in the compare page reasons list; it is not a separate component there and is out of scope for this contract.
Each section starts with a label row and a Lead paragraph (a bold opening plus rest), then the rows.

variants.name: operate
variants.description: Three rows; body is a bold lead sentence followed by longer text. Standard vertical spacing.

variants.name: values
variants.description: Five rows with a plain body sentence; larger vertical spacing (16, 20, 24) than the operate variant.

label.note: Eyebrow label with an icon. Observed 3 to 4 words.

lead.note: Lead paragraph with a bold opening. Observed 17 to 24 words.

boldLead.note: operate variant only; observed 12 to 17 words, rendered bold before the body.

body.note: operate: 35 to 51 words; values: 18 to 25 words.

motion.reducedMotionNote: No motion in the source; no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists in the code.

changes.change: title above body, each full width
two columns: title 4 of 12, body 8 of 12
title 5 of 24 columns, body 15 columns starting at column 9
title 6 columns from column 2, body 13 columns from column 11
